svg.text: Wind-tunnel fan – SINAMICS V20 (1AC 230 V, 0.75 kW) to 3~ fan motor in DELTA
Wiring diagram for the electrician – DRAFT, to be verified and installed by authorised personnel. Terminal numbers per V20 Operating Instructions 09/2014 (p. 39–44, 66).
1AC 230 V in / 3AC 230 V out, 0.75 kW, filtered
Terminals 1–16 are SELV – no mains potential!
M1 Fan motor 3~ (external rotor), wired in DELTA
≈16.7 Ω per winding, no nameplate – terminal names from polarity test
K1 NO, closed = motor OK → DI2 (9) ext. trip
S2 RESET, push button → DI3 (10) fault ack.
K1 must have safe isolation coil/contact (≥ 4 kV). The thermal contact has only basic
insulation to the winding, so it is kept on the mains side and never wired to V20 terminals.
1. Motor is connected in DELTA for a 3×230 V drive: U = Black + Red, V = Blue + Orange,
W = Brown + Grey (from winding polarity test, 13.11.2026).
2. Never place a switch or contactor between V20 output (U/V/W) and motor.
3. E-stop S0 removes the V20 supply via K0. V20 has no STO. After reset the fan does NOT
restart until S1 RUN is switched off/on (P1210 = 1).
4. Normal stop: S1 RUN off → ramp-down 20 s.
5. Max output 50 Hz (P1082). Wrong rotation: swap two of U/V/W at the drive, power off.
6. RCD 30 mA type A (see Siemens FAQ 49232264) or type B is permitted (manual p. 17).
7. Motor cable: shielded 4G1.0 mm², shield clamped at both ends; ≤ 10 m for class C2.
8. Control wiring 0.5–1.5 mm². Internal 24 V supply max 50 mA; 10 V max 11 mA.
9. Optional fault lamp on DO2 (terminal 18 NO / 19 C), max 230 V AC 0.5 A.
10. Before first run: insulation test 500 V, PE continuity, thermal trip test (F85),
E-stop test. Full parameter list: workbook sheet 'V20 Wiring'.
Drawn 13.11.2026 from bench measurements (Resistance + Polarity sheets) and SINAMICS V20 Operating Instructions A5E34559884. Status: DRAFT – not approved for installation.
